findings.source_quote: Those who rejected Him were blown away and disappeared from the narrative. Those who loved Him were set forth as the chosen ones who became the founders

findings.location: translation.html, paragraph beginning “Ons word nie die presiese toestand”
findings.source_quote: he was probably a well-dressed gentleman. Those who came shabbily dressed ... Most likely this man wanted to display his finery.
